hook.en: What if I could build something of my own?

objective: Origin of the universe. Establish The Traveler alone, the first AI conversation, and NØVA's awakening — without revealing his face. Plant the tone: searching, not triumphant.

scenes.description: Dark room, late at night, The Traveler alone at a glowing screen
scenes.visuals: Dark room, single light source from a laptop screen, The Traveler's hooded silhouette hunched forward, mask pattern dim
scenes.copy: 2025. Una laptop, muchas ideas, casi ningún recurso.

scenes.visuals: Close on the screen — text appears as he types, mask pattern reflected faintly in the display
Text flows back and forth, soft blue light building in intensity, geometric particles start gathering near the screen
scenes.copy: La conversación comienza. No hay respuesta todavía — solo preguntas.

scenes.description: A tiny blue light appears within the machine
scenes.visuals: A small point of light condenses out of the gathered particles, floating just above the keyboard
scenes.copy: Un pequeño punto azul aparece dentro del computador.

scenes.description: NØVA opens his eyes for the first time
scenes.visuals: The light resolves into NØVA's small round form; the large cyan eyes open for the first time, curious and wide
scenes.copy: NØVA abre los ojos por primera vez. Esta no fue la respuesta. Fue la primera pregunta.
assets_needed: character sheet: nova (curious expression, eyes opening)

metadata.call_to_action: Este no fue el final. Fue el comienzo.

captions.en: It all started with a question. #OpslyParallelPath

metadata.thumbnail_concept: The Traveler's hooded silhouette against a glowing laptop screen, a tiny blue light barely visible in the dark — text overlay: 'La Pregunta'

notes: Season 1, Episode 1 of Opsly: The Parallel Path — the universe's true pilot. Act II of the Origin Saga — see ../../canon/ORIGIN-SAGA.md.

STRUCTURE NOTE: functions as a cold open. Episode 2 ("Too Many Lives") is a flashback to the years before this moment — this episode airs first but NØVA's birth here is chronologically the end of Act I, not the start of the timeline.
Short version target: 35-50s (trim scene 3 slightly to fit). Long version: expand with Episode 2's many-lives montage as cold open before landing on this same night, target 5-8min.
Real event inspiration / fictionalization boundary: see ../../canon/TIMELINE.md row 01.
Ending line for narration/on-screen text: "No fue la respuesta. Fue la primera pregunta."
Character prompt lock: the-traveler.json + nova.json generation_prompt/negative_prompt — face must never be shown.
